meta.description:
A compact lattice of square chambers linked by deliberate cross-shaped passages. Repeating rooms provide landmarks, while central sightlines and alternating corridors make
    exploration readable without creating vast empty halls.
structural_rules: Arrange sixteen 3x3 chambers in a 4x4 grid.
Separate neighboring chambers with two-cell-wide wall bands.
Connect horizontal chamber neighbors through their middle row.
Connect vertical chamber neighbors through their central column.
Keep a continuous outer wall around the entire maze.
